description: This file defines a Python class 'LocalVectorStore' that manages a FAISS-based vector index, including methods for adding embeddings, searching, saving/loading the index, and retrieving statistics.

classes.name: LocalVectorStore
classes.description: FAISS-based local vector store for managing vector embeddings, including adding, searching, saving, and loading vectors.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the vector store with a specified dimension and creates a FAISS index.

methods.name: add_embeddings
methods.description: Adds a list of embeddings and associated metadata to the index.

methods.name: search
methods.description: Searches for similar vectors given a query embedding, with optional filtering by chapter.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the index and metadata to disk at the specified path.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads the index and metadata from disk from the specified path.

methods.name: get_stats
methods.description: Returns statistics about the vector store, including total vectors, dimension, and total metadata entries.
